facts.sentence: On Monday, Nov 2, 194 of the 293 elevators AGSIST reads posted a lower cash corn bid than Friday, 37 a higher one; 44 changed their basis, 7 weaker and 37 stronger.

facts.sentence: Corn basis on Nov 3 ran from 55¢ over December futures in Texas to 90¢ under in North Dakota, state medians of the elevators AGSIST read at 6:48 a.m. CT.
facts.detail: Median of 17 elevators in Texas, 48 in North Dakota. 15 states with 15 or more. USDA's North Dakota average on Nov 2: 89 under Dec (USDA AMS, North Dakota Daily Grain Bids, Nov 2, 2026).
facts.unit: cents per bushel between the strongest and weakest state median
